drafts.subject: Checking in after our call
drafts.body:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for the call today. To recap: you're sending the brand guidelines by Friday, and I'll have the revised logo draft to you on Monday. I'll also send the phase one invoice this week.

I've attached a short checklist that should make the feedback quicker. Does Thursday afternoon work for a quick check-in?

Best,
Alex
Nudge Dana if there is no reply.
